Name: Gas hob
Description: The four-burner gas hob on propane at 37 mbar (GasHobSpec.FourBurnerPropane, docs/GAS_HOB.md): smaller injectors, a faster flame, and unlit gas that pools in the burner wells, so a slow light is a bigger whoomph. Used like the natural gas hob. Place it with its back (+Z) to the wall. Not a recording and not a loop.
